messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] geom_smooth() error

2018-02-10 14:09 GMT+01:00 Shiwei <slende...@gmail.com>:
> Hello,
>
> Just started using simmer and R, can someone help me with this error
> (coloured red)?
>
>> arrivals <- get_mon_arrivals(env)
>> arrivals2 <- get_mon_arrivals(env, per_resource =T)
>> plot(arrivals, metric="waiting_time")
> `geom_smooth()` using method = 'gam'

simmer.plot depends on ggplot2. That's ggplot2 emitting a warning, and
it's fine: it's telling you which method it chose for the smoothing.

>>
>>
> Kind regards,
> S
>
